submission.type: full paper, single-track, double-blind; from RSS 2025 a title/abstract registration one week before the full paper; RSS 2027 introduces a two-stage process (6-page extended abstract -> rebuttal -> Extension Charter -> final paper)
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: Historically late January / early February (AoE) for the full paper (2022: Jan 29; 2023: Feb 3; 2024: Feb 2; 2025: Jan 24 with abstract Jan 17; 2026: Jan 30 with abstract Jan 23). RSS 2027: extended abstract due Dec 4, 2026.
submission.typical_final_deadline: Notification ~late April/May; camera-ready ~mid/late May (2023: May 28; 2027: final paper Apr 16, acceptance Apr 30, camera-ready May 14, 2027).
submission.notes: abstract_deadline fields hold the FULL PAPER (initial paper) deadline for 2015-2026; for 2027 it holds the Stage-1 extended abstract deadline, which is the first binding submission. Page limits: historically 8 pages + references (e.g. RSS 2016); RSS 2027 Stage 1 = 6 pages (5 content + 1 references), final paper max 8 pages excluding references. Double-blind (anonymized submissions). No RA-L/journal option (RSS is not an IEEE conference; proceedings at roboticsproceedings.org).

next_edition.notes: Call for papers published; Stage-1 extended abstract (6 pages: 5 content + 1 references, anonymized) due Dec 4, 2026 23:59 AoE. Final papers (max 8 pages excl. references) due Apr 16, 2027 for papers invited to Stage 2.
